message.content:
The most recent estimates put the United States’ Gini coefficient at roughly **0.41–0.43** (depending on the year and the data source).  

| Year | Source | Gini (US) |
|------|--------|-----------|
| 2019 | World Bank (income, 2019) | 0.421 |
| 2021 | OECD (income, 2021) | 0.434 |
| 2022 | U.S. Census Bureau (income, 2022) | 0.432 |

> **Interpretation** – A Gini coefficient of 0.41–0.43 indicates moderate income inequality; 0 would mean perfect equality and 1 would mean perfect inequality.

If you need the exact figure for a specific year or a different definition (e.g., wealth Gini), let me know and I can look up the precise data.
